subject: Data Engineering
title: Models and Refs in dbt
description: A short lesson to help you apply Models and Refs in dbt.

hook.text: In dbt, every SQL file is a model. Models reference each other using a simple function called ref.

buildup.text: A model is a SELECT statement that defines a table or view. The ref function creates dependencies between models.

discovery.text: dbt reads all refs and builds a dependency graph, ensuring models run in the correct order automatically.

twist.text: If model C depends on B which depends on A, dbt knows to run A first — without you writing orchestration logic.

climax.text: The ref system turns scattered SQL scripts into an organized, dependency-aware transformation pipeline.

punchline.text: Write SQL. Use ref. dbt handles the order.

quiz.question: What does the ref function do in dbt?
options: Creates dependencies between models for correct execution order
